leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useId hook to generate stable unique identifiers within React components.
Construct a form component with multiple input fields that require unique IDs.
Utilize generated IDs to associate labels with their corresponding input elements using htmlFor attributes.
Implement the useId hook with string concatenation to create IDs for related form elements.
Access the generated ID value to assign it to both label and input elements in JSX.
Control ID generation by invoking useId at the component level to ensure consistency across renders.
Define a reusable form field component that internally manages its own stable IDs.
Modify existing form components to replace hardcoded IDs with useId-generated stable identifiers.
Compare the behavior of useId-generated IDs versus manually created IDs during component re-renders.
Execute conditional rendering scenarios where useId maintains ID stability across mounting/unmounting cycles.
Store generated IDs in component variables to reference them multiple times within the same component.
Return JSX elements with properly associated label-input pairs using stable IDs from useId.
